## Who I Am

I am a Postgraduate Business Analytics student at Dublin City University, dedicated to leveraging data-driven insights to optimize customer-centric strategies and operational efficiency.

My professional perspective is built upon a foundation in International Business and Trade, further enriched by practical experience in the retail sector in Hermosillo, Sonora, Mexico. During my time in customer-facing roles, I developed an acute understanding of how supply chain dynamics, pricing fluctuations, and seasonal trends directly influence consumer behavior. This firsthand observation of market variables served as the catalyst for my transition into the field of advanced analytics.

Currently, I am refining my technical proficiency in Python, SQL, and Tableau to translate complex datasets into actionable business intelligence. I aim to combine my international business background with rigorous quantitative analysis to help organizations bridge the gap between high-level global strategy and localized operational impact.

I am passionate about transforming raw data into clear, strategic narratives that drive growth and enhance the customer experience.

::: {.callout-note}

## What I Do

I work at the intersection of international business strategy and data analytics. My focus is on translating quantitative findings into clear, strategic narratives that inform decision-making — particularly in customer behaviour, retail operations, and market dynamics.
